title: 第四章 黑鼎
content_zh:
看到玄阳捂住李火旺的嘴巴，拿着火匣子的其他人迅速冲上来，眼神不善的把李火旺围成一团。
“不走是吧？那你今天就死在这里吧！我们绝对不可能让你去给那癞子头通风报信的!”
对于自己目前生死处境，李火旺却半点都不慌张，他无语的翻了一个白眼后，心中暗骂一句这幻觉的剧情走向，直接闭上了眼睛开始深吸一口气。
等他再次睁开眼睛时，发现自己已经被宽皮带束缚在病床上，围着自己那些师兄师弟已经消失了。
“王阿姨，我醒了，能不能帮我松开啊？”李火旺对着床头的麦克风呼喊着夜班护士，他迫切想想看看那玉佩现在是不是在自己的衣服里。
然而喊了半天却没有反应，李火旺明白，王护士又在值夜班的时候偷偷追玛丽苏电视局了，她总是这么喜欢偷懒。
李火旺低着看着自己那被蓝白色的病服裹着的胸口，拼命扭动，想要通过挤压来感知胸口到底有没有玉佩。
可是他现在身体被束缚的死死的，又感觉有又感觉没有。试了几次后就无奈的放弃了。
打了一个哈切的李火旺现状只能躺在床上，祈祷王护士追完剧后，大发慈悲的看一下的摄像头了。
深夜环境下，哪怕就是关重症患者的二楼也十分安静，李火旺昏昏沉沉的睡了过去。等他再次醒来时发现自己已经躺在了冰冷的溶洞地上。
自己还在那个位置，但是之前那些企图逃跑的家伙已经一个不见了。
“切，就你们这帮NPC也想对付我？”李火旺从怀里掏出玉佩在手心轻轻颠了颠，重新塞进自己的怀里。
当他重新回到自己住的大通铺，躺在干草堆中耐心的等待着白天的到来，一想到玉佩的价值，他现在兴奋的根本睡不着。
没有时钟的情况下，李火旺也不知道过了多久，当他看到两旁的师兄弟开始醒了过来，自己便也坐了起来。
“这边天亮了，那么王阿姨也该换班了吧。要不我现在先回去看看？艾护士可比她敬业多了。”
就在李火旺正在犹豫的时候，门口传来一阵急促的脚步声。
一个身穿黑色道袍，头顶束发的道童慌张的从外面钻了进来。
“都快些！师尊让所有人去惠安殿集合！！”
这突如其来的消息让所有人都摸不到头脑，但是既然是师傅要去，他们也没有拒绝的理由。
很快，在所谓惠安殿的最大溶洞内，所有弟子都到齐了，火把的光芒把所有人脸上的疑惑都照的清清楚楚。

李火旺敏锐的察觉到了一点，人群中少了一些，除了玄阳外，居然也少了癞子头师傅的几个亲传弟子。
“哎呦，这是跟着一起逃跑了？”他看热闹不嫌事大的想着，眼前的一幕让他有种追剧的感觉。
当一个脑袋从黑暗的蠕动隧道探了出来，除了李火旺外，所有人道童下意识的垂下脑袋。
那是他们的师傅，丹阳子。
“咳~！”一声咳嗽让所有人浑身一紧。
“昨个晚上二更天的时候，有人要逃，其中还包括道爷的两位亲传弟子，本道爷我很是心痛！！”
口中说的是心痛，可他那脸上的戾气却大的几乎快要凝聚成实质。
“这就被发现了？玄阳这些家伙真够逊的。”李火旺撇了撇嘴。
“所谓无规矩不成方圆，犯错必受罚，这就是我西山东华派的规矩！都随我来。”
所有弟子大气不敢喘，默默的跟着丹阳子的后面向前走。
穿过大大小小的溶洞，又从一条湍急的地下河边穿过，很快他们来到了一间教室大小的潮湿溶洞内。
李火旺看到，昨天晚上逃跑的那些人一个不拉全被五花大绑的堆在墙角。
表情萎靡的他们看到自己的师傅，顿时激动着挣扎着，似乎想要诉说着什么，但是他们嘴里的碎布却阻止他们什么都说不了。
丹阳子仿佛也不想听他们的辩解，单手内翻结道印向前一指。“开！”
溶洞那被冲刷的光滑地面瞬间
下一刻从洞内，歇斯底里的闷喊声跟惨叫声伴随着血肉撕裂声还有骨头断裂声不断响起，
面对这恐怖的一幕，不少道童双腿已经开始打颤，双眼更是恨不得闭上。
“给我靠近些！这就是他们逃跑的下场！”丹阳子的话让所有人的脸唰的一下白了好几个度。
师傅的命令谁也不敢违背，所有人推搡的走到洞边。
洞里很黑，非常黑，漆黑一片。

漆黑的圆形洞穴如同一个漩涡，仿佛要把所有人都陷进去。
李火旺仔细辨认后，看到洞内是一口大黑鼎，鼎口的边缘筑压着某些扭曲的符箓。
鼎内似乎有什么东西在动，但是李火旺始终看不清楚，他唯一用器官接收到的信息就是里面刺鼻令人作呕的血腥味。
不管这里面装的东西是什么，但是可以肯定绝对非常危险。
“幻觉里面的东西按理来说应该不会伤害到我才对，以前从来没有发生那种事情。”
话虽然这么说，但是他的心却悬了起来，打算随时准备退回到医院去。
“唰—！”一圈蠕动的黑影瞬间从洞里钻出，裹着李火旺身旁的一位师弟猛地缩了回去。
所有人被这一幕吓坏了，纷纷后退到溶洞那光滑的墙壁边上，要不是丹阳子就在旁边盯着，他们怕是早就跑出去。
在场几乎所有人的表情此时都变得十分的惶恐，心中在颤抖的猜测刚刚那东西是什么。
可这些猜测的人中并不包括李火旺，因为刚刚他站的最近，所以他看清楚了。
那是一团有着肉质纹理黑色的物质，滑腻粘稠的皮肤上长着一丛丛短小的、不断颤动的黑色触手！
单凭这一点，李火旺可以肯定，丹阳子在这洞里饲养的东西绝对不是世间存在的正常东西。
至于究竟是什么，李火旺猜不出来也不想再走过去重新看一遍。
虽然知道这些东西都是他大脑里面冒出来的，可李火旺真想明白自己虚幻出来的东西为什么会有这种东西？
李火旺打量着四周无比真实的一切，心中忽然有了一个可怕的猜想。“难道这可怕诡异的世界是真的？”
这个猜想瞬间让李火旺的身体颤抖起来，他想到了之前死去的那些人，如果那些人都是真的并不是自己的幻觉的话，那自己刚刚被那东西拽住也会死？
李火旺几乎要被这令人窒息的恐惧压垮，他用力的深吸了几口，马上按照李医生教导的方式进行自我开导。
“这些都是幻觉，哪怕再真实都是幻觉，李火旺，你绝对不能再迷失到这些幻觉中去了，他们都是你创造的，你怕什么。”
“杨娜还在等我呢，我不能辜负她。我能战胜这一切！一定能！”
经过李火旺的自我开解，他的情绪逐渐稳定下来，足以坦然的面前眼前的一切了。
content_en:
Seeing Xuanyang cover Li Huowang's mouth, other people with fire boxes rushed up quickly and surrounded Li Huowang with evil eyes.
"You're not leaving, are you? Then you'll die here today! There's absolutely no way we'll let you tip off that scoundrel!"
Regarding his current life and death situation, Li Huowang was not panicked at all. After he rolled his eyes speechlessly, he cursed in his mind the direction of the hallucination plot, closed his eyes and began to take a deep breath.
When he opened his eyes again, he found that he was restrained on the hospital bed by a wide belt, and the brothers and sisters surrounding him had disappeared.
"Aunt Wang, I'm awake, can you help me loosen it?" Li Huowang called the night nurse into the bedside microphone. He was eager to see if the jade pendant was in his clothes now.
However, after shouting for a long time, there was no response. Li Huowang understood that Nurse Wang was secretly chasing Mary Sue TV Bureau during the night shift. She always liked to be lazy.
Li Huowang looked down at his chest wrapped in a blue and white hospital gown, twisting desperately, trying to squeeze to feel whether there was a jade pendant on his chest.
But now his body is tightly restrained, and he can feel it and not feel it at the same time. After trying a few times, I reluctantly gave up.
Li Huowang, who had been beaten, could only lie on the bed, praying that Nurse Wang would be merciful and look at the camera after finishing the drama.
In the late night environment, even the second floor where critically ill patients were kept was very quiet, and Li Huowang fell into a drowsy sleep. When he woke up again, he found himself lying on the cold cave floor.
He was still in that position, but none of the guys who tried to escape before were gone.
"Tch, you NPCs are the only ones who want to deal with me?" Li Huowang took out the jade pendant from his arms, shook it gently in his palm, and stuffed it into his arms again.
When he returned to Datongpu where he lived, he lay in the haystack and waited patiently for the day to come. When he thought of the value of the jade pendant, he was so excited that he couldn't sleep at all.
Without a clock, Li Huowang didn't know how much time had passed. When he saw the brothers on both sides starting to wake up, he also sat up.
"It's dawn here, so it's time for Aunt Wang to change her shift. How about I go back and take a look now? Nurse Ai is much more dedicated than her."
Just when Li Huowang was hesitating, there was a rush of footsteps at the door.
A Taoist boy wearing a black Taoist robe and with hair tied on his head came in from the outside in a panic.
"Hurry up! Master asks everyone to gather at Hui'an Hall!!"
This sudden news left everyone confused, but since the master was going, they had no reason to refuse.
Soon, all the disciples arrived in the largest cave of the so-called Hui'an Hall, and the light of the torches clearly illuminated the doubts on everyone's faces.
Li Huowang was keenly aware that there were fewer people in the crowd. In addition to Xuanyang, there were also a few direct disciples of Master Leizitou.
"Hey, are you running away with them?" He thought to himself as he was watching the excitement. The scene in front of him made him feel like he was following a drama.
When a head poked out from the dark crawling tunnel, all the humane boys except Li Huowang lowered their heads subconsciously.
That was their master, Danyangzi.
"Cough~!" A cough made everyone tense up.
"Last night at the second watch, someone wanted to escape, including two of Taoist master's direct disciples. I am very heartbroken for this Taoist master!!"
What he said was heartache, but the anger on his face was so strong that it almost condensed into substance.
"Have you been discovered yet? Guys like Xuanyang are really mean." Li Huowang curled his lips.
"As the saying goes, there is no rule without rules. If you make a mistake, you will be punished. These are the rules of my Xishan Donghua sect! Come with me."
All the disciples did not dare to take a breath and remained silentHe followed Danyangzi and walked forward.
Passing through large and small caves, and passing by a rapid underground river, they soon arrived at a humid cave the size of a classroom.
Li Huowang saw that those who escaped last night were all tied up and piled in the corner.
When they saw their master with depressed expressions, they suddenly became excited and struggled, as if they wanted to tell something, but the rags in their mouths prevented them from saying anything.
Danyangzi didn't seem to want to hear their excuses, so he turned his hand inward and pointed forward. "Open!"
The moment the smooth washed floor of the cave
The next moment, hysterical shouts and screams were heard from inside the cave, accompanied by the sounds of tearing flesh and blood and the sounds of broken bones.
Faced with this horrific scene, many Taoist boys' legs began to tremble, and their eyes even wanted to close.
"Get closer to me! This is what they will get if they run away!" Danyangzi's words made everyone's faces turn several shades white.
No one dared to disobey the master's orders, and everyone pushed and pushed to the edge of the cave.
The cave was dark, very dark, pitch black.
The dark circular cave was like a whirlpool, as if it was about to trap everyone.
After Li Huowang carefully identified it, he saw that there was a large black cauldron inside the cave, with some twisted talismans built on the edge of the cauldron's mouth.
There seemed to be something moving inside the cauldron, but Li Huowang could not see clearly. The only information he received with his organs was the pungent and disgusting smell of blood inside.
No matter what is inside, it is definitely very dangerous.
"Logically speaking, the things in the hallucination shouldn't hurt me. That kind of thing has never happened before."
Even though he said this, his heart was in doubt and he was ready to return to the hospital at any time.
"Wha—!" A circle of squirming black shadows instantly emerged from the hole, wrapping a junior brother next to Li Huowang and shrinking back suddenly.
Everyone was frightened by this scene and retreated to the smooth wall of the cave. If Danyangzi hadn't been watching next to them, they would have run out long ago.
The expressions of almost everyone present became very frightened at this time, and their hearts were tremblingly guessing what that thing was.
But these guessers did not include Li Huowang, because he was standing closest just now, so he could see clearly.
It was a mass of black substance with a fleshy texture, and there were clusters of short, trembling black tentacles on the smooth and sticky skin!
Based on this alone, Li Huowang can be sure that the things Danyangzi raised in this cave are definitely not normal things that exist in the world.
As for what it was, Li Huowang couldn't guess it and didn't want to go over and look at it again.
Although he knew that these things came out of his brain, Li Huowang really wanted to understand why his imaginary things had such things?
Li Huowang looked at everything that was extremely real around him, and suddenly had a terrible suspicion in his heart. "Is this scary and weird world real?"
This conjecture instantly made Li Huowang's body tremble. He thought of the people who had died before. If those people were real and not his hallucinations, would he have died just now when he was pulled by that thing?
Li Huowang was almost overwhelmed by this suffocating fear. He took a few deep breaths and immediately enlightened himself according to the method taught by Dr. Li.
"These are all illusions, no matter how real they are. Li Huowang, you must not get lost in these illusions anymore. They were all created by you. What are you afraid of?"
"Yang Na is still waiting for me. I can't let her down. I can defeat all this! I definitely can!"
After Li Huowang's self-explanation, his mood gradually stabilized, enough to calmly face everything in front of him.
